acceptance.given: An applicable Consumer is identified from the frozen Consumer Manifest and has a current, bound Candidate Route identity.

oracle.expected: The test records an actual Candidate Route invocation and successful enable result through that Consumer's real repository call surface.
forbidden: No Candidate Route invocation is recorded.
A simulated, mocked, configuration-only, or non-real call surface is treated as enable execution.
oracle.observable: The Consumer invocation receipt and result expose the Candidate Route call made during enable.

acceptance.then: Enable has been executed through the applicable Consumer's real call surface.
acceptance.when: The FR-10 enable transition is exercised by the real Consumer selector.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the Consumer enable selector with a no-call or simulated-call witness and require a missing real Candidate Route receipt to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make the Toolchain replay entrypoint drive enable through each applicable Consumer's real Candidate Route call surface and expose an attributable invocation receipt; do not accept a simulated or configuration-only transition.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve replay interfaces and do not alter Phase, runtime, or user-sandbox state; rollback removes only the real-call enable handling.

slice_hint.state_transition: An applicable Consumer requiring enable execution transitions to invoking the bound Candidate Route through its real call surface and recording the result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The FR-10 selector observes a successful real Candidate Route invocation for enable; an absent, simulated, or configuration-only invocation fails.

acceptance.given: A TC-D1 Toolchain write request resolves to a path within a user-sandbox boundary.

oracle.expected: The Toolchain boundary check rejects the request before a user-sandbox path is written, and the targeted sandbox path remains unchanged.
forbidden: Allowing a user-sandbox boundary write during TC-D1 work.
oracle.observable: The boundary validator reports rejection for the attempted user-sandbox write and the protected target has no change.

acceptance.then: The rejected user-sandbox target remains outside the Toolchain write set and unchanged.
acceptance.when: The boundary validator evaluates an attempted write to a user-sandbox path before replay work is applied.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the Toolchain scope-boundary negative validator with a user-sandbox write target and require an allowed write to fail the validator.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce rejection of TC-D1 write targets that resolve within user-sandbox paths before Toolchain replay work can write them.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: The guard only narrows unauthorized TC-D1 writes; it does not mutate user-sandbox state or alter Phase/runtime schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: An attempted TC-D1 write targeting a user-sandbox path transitions to rejection before any filesystem mutation.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The boundary validator rejects the user-sandbox write attempt and the target remains unchanged.
